description: Move a printer axis to a relative position

direction.description: Axis and direction to move. Use axis letter, optionally with minus for negative. Examples: "X" (+X), "X-" (-X), "Y", "Y-", "Z", "Z-"

snippet_id.description: ID of a gcode snippet to send. Either gcode, macro, or snippet_id is required.

speed.description: Movement speed in mm/min. If not specified, uses printer default.

name: move_printer_axis
